name: SonarQube & SonarCloud Integration
description: Integration pack for SonarQube and SonarCloud, providing connectivity to static code analysis, Quality Gate evaluation, SAST security vulnerability detection, code coverage reporting, and technical debt measurement.

capabilities.name: Quality Engineering & Hardening
capabilities.description: Integrates SonarQube Quality Gate status, code coverage metrics, and maintainability ratings.

capabilities.name: Security Engineering
capabilities.description: Integrates SonarQube SAST Security Hotspots, Security Vulnerabilities, and OWASP Top 10 compliance.

capabilities.name: Code Review
capabilities.description: Integrates automated Pull Request quality comments and inline code smell annotations.

checklists.name: SonarQube Integration Verification Checklist
checklists.description: Validation checklist for SonarQube API user token, Quality Gate evaluation, and SCM PR decoration.

items.statement: SonarQube User Token authenticates scanner CLI and REST API calls.
SonarQube Quality Gate conditions enforce zero new critical bugs and minimum 80% code coverage on new code.
SonarQube Webhook reports Quality Gate pass/fail status back to CI build pipelines.

reviewGates.name: SonarQube Quality Gate Review Gate
reviewGates.statement: The Quality Lead confirms that SonarQube Quality Gates and SAST security scans satisfy software quality standards.
reviewGates.prompt: Does the SonarQube integration confirm Quality Gate enforcement and PR code decoration?
